description: This source file implements the ElseIf class, representing an 'else-if' condition in a mini-language processing framework within the OFBiz project. It handles parsing of XML elements that define 'else-if' logic, evaluation of the condition, and execution of associated sub-operations.

classes.name: ElseIf
classes.description: Represents an 'else-if' conditional element in the mini-language, encapsulating condition evaluation and associated sub-operations execution.

methods.name: ElseIf
methods.description: Constructor that parses XML element to initialize the ElseIf object, validating child elements and creating the condition and sub-operations.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Evaluates the stored condition against the current method context.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects artifact information by delegating to all sub-operations.

methods.name: getThenSubOps
methods.description: Returns the list of sub-operations to execute if the condition evaluates to true.

methods.name: runSubOps
methods.description: Executes the sub-operations associated with this 'else-if' when the condition is true.
